text.en:
1. This Act may be cited as the Redemptorist Fathers
(Incorporation) Act, 1962.

2. In this Act unless the context otherwise requires—

"the Corporation" means the body incorporated under
the name of "Titular Superior of the Redemptorist Fathers
in the Federation of Malaya" by the provisions of this Act.

3. The Reverend Father  Gregory  Dobson, the Titular
Superior of the Redemptorist Fathers in the Federation and
his successors for the time being in office shall be a body
corporate by the name of |"Titular Superior of the
Redemptorist Fathers in the Federation of Malaya" and
by the same name shall have perpetual succession and may
enter into contracts, and may acquire, purchase, take hold
and enjoy movable and immovable property of every
description, and may convey, transfer, assign, surrender and
yield up, charge, mortgage, demise, reassign or otherwise
dispose of, or deal with,  any movable or immovable
property vested in the Corporation upon such terms as to
the Corporation may seem fit, and by the same name may
sue and be sued in all courts and in all manner of actions
and suits and may do all other matters and things incidental
or appertaining to a body corporate.

4. (1) The Corporation shall have a common seal, and such
seal may from time to time be broken, changed, altered and
made anew as to the Serporauon seems fit.

(2) No deed, document or other instrument sealed with
the seal of the Corporation shall be deemed to be duly
sealed unless—

(a) such seal has been affixed in the presence of the
said Reverend Father Gregory Dobson or of his
successor for the time being in office, as the case
may be, or of the attorney of either of them, duly
authorised by a po er of attorney registered
under the Powers of Attorney Ordinance, 1949;
and

(b) such deed, document or other instrument is signed
by the said Reverend Father or his successor or
by the attorney of either of them.

(3) Such signing shall be taken as sufficient evidence of

the due sealing of such deed, document or other instru-
ments.

5. A notification in the Gazette of the appointment of any
person to hold, or act in, the office of Titular Superior of the
Redemptorist Fathers in the Federation of Malaya shall be

conclusive evidence that such person was duly so appointed.

6. On the coming into force of this Act all and every
property belonging to the Titular Superior of the
Redemptorist Fathers in the Federation of Malaya, whether
held in the name of such Titular Superior or in the name
or names of any person or persons in trust for him, shall be
and the same is hereby vested in the Corporation, and the
same together with all after-acquired property movable or
immovable, and all subscriptions, contributions, donations,
fines, amounts of loans and advances received or to be

received shall be held by the Corporation for the purposes

of this Act and subject to the rules for the time being of the
Corporation.                       |

7. All debts and liabilities of the Titular Superior of the
Redemptorist Fathers existing at the time of the coming
into force of this Act shall be paid by the Corporation, and
all debts due to and subscriptions and contributions pay-
able to such Titular Superior shall be paid to the Corpora-
tion for the purposes of this Act.

REDEMPTORIST FATHERS (INCORPORATION)     219

8. Nothing in this Act shall affect the rights of the Yang di- Saving of
Pertuan Agong, the Rulers or the Governors or of any body  rights.
politic or corporate or of any other persons except such as

are mentioned in this Act and those claiming by, from or

under them.
